definitions.gloss: ethics; moral philosophy; the study of ethics
definitions.explanation: The branch of philosophy concerned with questions of right and wrong conduct, moral values, and the nature of the good life. Studied as an academic discipline at universities and in philosophy departments, distinct from the everyday sense of {倫理|りんり} (ethics, morals) that one might apply to personal conduct.

notes:
Formed from ⟦{倫理|りんり}→倫理：05098_rinri⟧ (ethics, morals) + ⟦{学|がく}→〜学：09846_gaku⟧ (study of, -ology). The academic, systematic study of moral principles, as opposed to everyday moral intuitions.

USAGE:
- Primarily an academic term — used in university courses, textbooks, and scholarly writing.
- In Japanese high schools, a subject called ⟦{倫理|りんり}→倫理：05098_rinri⟧ (often just "ethics" on the curriculum) covers introductory moral philosophy and Eastern/Western thinkers.
- Modifiers specify subfields: ⟦{応用|おうよう}→応用：04135_ouyou⟧{倫理学|りんりがく} (applied ethics), ⟦{医療|いりょう}→医療：01836_iryou⟧{倫理学|りんりがく} (medical ethics), ⟦{環境|かんきょう}→環境：00174_kankyou⟧{倫理学|りんりがく} (environmental ethics).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {倫理学|りんりがく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{学|まな}ぶ→学ぶ：01987_manabu⟧: to study ethics
- {倫理学|りんりがく}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{教授|きょうじゅ}→教授：02589_kyouju⟧: professor of ethics
- {倫理学|りんりがく}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{授業|じゅぎょう}→授業：00781_jugyou⟧: ethics class
- ⟦{応用|おうよう}→応用：04135_ouyou⟧{倫理学|りんりがく}: applied ethics
- ⟦{西洋|せいよう}→西洋：01446_seiyou⟧{倫理学|りんりがく}: Western ethics

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{倫理|りんり}→倫理：05098_rinri⟧: ethics, morals — the subject matter rather than the academic study
- ⟦{道徳|どうとく}→道徳：03478_doutoku⟧: morals, morality — overlaps with ⟦{倫理|りんり}→倫理：05098_rinri⟧ but emphasizes social norms and rules of conduct
- ⟦{哲学|てつがく}→哲学：03548_tetsugaku⟧: philosophy — the broader discipline that includes ethics
- ⟦{道徳|どうとく}→道徳：03478_doutoku⟧⟦{哲学|てつがく}→哲学：03548_tetsugaku⟧: moral philosophy — alternative, more Western-oriented name for the same field
